name: Glass Shatter
description: Full-screen WebGL image that cracks like broken glass around the click point, with shards displaced and shaded by a fragment shader. Space toggles the effect.
contents: Full-bleed canvas rendering one image through a shatter shader
Optional hint label at the bottom
behavior: Clicking the canvas moves the impact point and generates a new random crack pattern
Space key toggles the shatter distortion on and off
Canvas resizes with its container and caps pixel ratio

props.name: tipText
props.default: Click to break, space to toggle

editableByProps: Image, background class, hint text and its classes, hint visibility
Shatter strength, crack edge thickness, initial crack seed, initial impact point, effect on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change crack count or sector shapes
needsCodeEdit.where: FRAG_SHADER constant, the for loop in main

needsCodeEdit.change: Change image zoom inside the canvas

fixed: Document-level Space keydown listener toggles the effect and calls preventDefault, which blocks page scrolling by Space while mounted
Root fills the viewport height (h-screen) and is full width; override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto
Requires WebGL and a CORS-enabled image
